name: Matthew T. Bach, Attorney at Law
what_they_do: Boutique solo law office of Matthew T. Bach, JD/MBA, who came to the US in 1976 and spent about 14 years at Bristol-Myers Squibb before opening the practice; admitted in NJ in 1995. Listed services are immigration, real estate (residential and commercial), estate planning, business formation, mergers/acquisitions, civil litigation, landlord-tenant, land use/zoning, and traffic violations. The site sells personal attention - the attorney says clients always reach him directly, and the office says it grew mainly by referral.
customers: Individuals and small businesses in Middlesex County: immigrants and families, home and commercial property buyers/sellers, and small-business owners.

size_signals.signal: One attorney, single office at 1566 US Route 130; site says 'I' throughout with no staff or paralegals named
Contact e-mail is a personal Gmail address (attorneybach@gmail.com) rather than a domain address
Memberships: American Immigration Lawyers Association, NJ Immigration Lawyers Association, NJ/Middlesex bar associations

website_review.primary_cta: 'REACH OUT' button scrolling to the contact form; single-page structure
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Contact form only (name, e-mail, subject, message); no booking or quote
website_review.trust_signals: Attorney biography with bar admissions and court admissions, professional memberships, 'grown mostly through referrals' copy; no reviews, no photos of work, no testimonials
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Not dated anywhere (no copyright line); page is clean Webflow with working mobile layout
website_review.search_basics: Page title is simply 'Home' and there is no meta description, so search results show nothing about service or town; one long single page for nine practice areas, so no per-service URLs; 0 JSON-LD blocks
top_issues: Title 'Home' with no meta description - invisible in search for 'immigration lawyer North Brunswick'
No LocalBusiness/Attorney schema and no per-practice-area pages
No click-to-call link and no phone number in the mobile header
Form fields rely on placeholders only, with no labels

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: no Google Business Profile surfaced (Avvo only, 2 reviews), and robots.txt returns 404 so nothing is blocked but there is also no sitemap. Answerable: address, phone, fax and the service list are real text, but there is no schema, no hours and no fee information, and the title/description tell a crawler nothing. Bookable: a working contact form with an e-mail field, but fields are unlabelled (0 label elements) and it is a plain 'Name/Email/Subject/Message' form - an agent could submit an enquiry, not book.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the site's search footprint: real titles and descriptions per service, dedicated pages for immigration and real estate, and Attorney/LocalBusiness schema with address, phone and hours
top_opportunities.evidence: document.title is 'Home', there is no meta description, 0 JSON-LD blocks, and all nine services sit on one page

top_opportunities.opportunity: Turn the anonymous contact form into a labelled intake that captures matter type and auto-replies, so enquiries from referrals do not sit in a Gmail inbox
top_opportunities.evidence: Form posts a generic Name/Email/Subject/Message; no labels; the public contact address is attorneybach@gmail.com

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete a Google Business Profile and start collecting reviews (currently 2 on Avvo, none on Google)
top_opportunities.evidence: Only Avvo shows reviews (5.0 from 2); no Google listing surfaced for the office at 1566 US Route 130

scores.reasons: Gap: visually modern but effectively unsearchable - title 'Home', no description, no schema, no service pages. Ability to pay: true solo with a Gmail contact address, so budget is limited. Ease: clean Webflow site, straightforward rebuild plus schema. Evidence: read the live page, form markup, robots.txt and mobile render.
